description: This file contains functions for automating stock-related operations in an ERP system, including creating purchase receipts, delivery notes, stock reconciliations, and handling stock entries, returns, and related error handling.

methods.name: work
methods.description: Main function to perform various stock operations such as creating purchase receipts, delivery notes, stock reconciliations, and processing returns.

methods.name: make_purchase_receipt
methods.description: Creates purchase receipt documents based on purchase orders, with handling for subcontracted items and stock errors.

methods.name: make_delivery_note
methods.description: Generates delivery notes from sales orders, setting expense accounts and handling stock errors.

methods.name: make_stock_reconciliation
methods.description: Creates stock reconciliation documents, possibly marking items as damaged, with error handling for stock and account issues.

methods.name: submit_draft_stock_entries
methods.description: Attempts to submit older draft stock entries, with error handling for various stock and validation errors.

methods.name: make_sales_return_records
methods.description: Creates sales return records from delivered notes, with probabilistic execution.

methods.name: make_purchase_return_records
methods.description: Creates purchase return records from purchase receipts, with probabilistic execution.
